kurz: Pectin is the glue in plant cells. With sugar and acid it forms gels; when vegetables cook, it dissolves.
bild_im_kopf: The same mortar that holds vegetables together makes jam set.
was_passiert: In fruit and vegetables, pectin binds the cells together. Extracted and boiled with a lot of sugar and acid, it forms a gel.
faustregeln: [[gelierzucker|Jam sugar]] already contains pectin and acid.
